'''Virtual Set 1: Legacy (Premium Edition)''' is the [[Players Committee]]'s '''Virtual Set #1 Premium Edition''' presentation of the twelve cards in [[Virtual Set 1: Legacy]]. The source is a one-page sheet of lower-card slips, designed to be cut out and sleeved with their underlying [[Decipher]] cards. Its footer reads “SWCCG Player’s Committee 2002”.<ref name="premium-source">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards1Premium.pdf Virtual Set #1 Premium Edition], [[Players Committee]], one-page slip sheet, printed footer year 2002. Wiki copy: [[Media:VirtualCards1Premium.pdf|original PDF]]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008193754/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards1Premium.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>

The Premium Edition uses production-style lower-card frames and an icon key. The circled Pilot marker followed by a number replaces the corresponding piloting power bonus and counts as a [[Pilot]] icon. ▲ means “take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle”, ▼ means “deploy on table from Reserve Deck; reshuffle”, and the crossed-out Alter marker means “Immune to Alter.” The sheet also defines Control and Sense immunity markers.<ref name="premium-source" />

== Cards ==
The card images below are the Premium Edition slips. Their articles retain the printed shorthand; the sheet's icon key explains its meaning.
